verdict: A very close, well-structured rebuild whose main gaps are Inter standing in for SF Pro (with a few px of vertical drift) and an opaque tab bar that loses the reference's blurred, faded feed underneath; editable with components for repeated rows but no shared styles.

top_defects.where: whole screen (titles, card text, tab labels)
top_defects.what: Inter instead of SF Pro: wider glyphs and different letterforms, so lines drift to the right along their length (heatmap doubles every text edge; second Top read row truncates at 'mus…' instead of 'mu…'); 'Community' segment heavier than the reference

top_defects.where: tab bar and the feed behind it
top_defects.what: reference's Liquid Glass bar shows the 'Liste de sondages…' row blurred through it and fades rank 3 to ~30 % opacity; candidate bar is near-opaque white and row 3 (circle, title, description) is drawn at full contrast

top_defects.where: large title 'Today', card hidden banner, section headers, cards
top_defects.what: content sits about 3–4 px (@3x) lower from the large title downward, about 6 px at the Top read card; horizontal margins and widths match
tab items are four copied frames rather than instances, and no color/text styles or variables are used (styled: 0): #202122, #72777d, #3366cc repeated as raw values

top_defects.where: Top read #3 thumbnail behind the tab bar
top_defects.what: full Star Academy logo shown in black at full contrast; the reference shows a tighter, zoomed crop ('tar / ader') faded under the bar

strengths: Every text, icon and photo of the reference is present with correct French content, colors (#3366cc links, #72777d secondary) and card positions/widths
Status bar, navigation buttons and tab bar icons redrawn as vectors in the right SF Symbol shapes, with the selected Home capsule in blue
Section header, game event row and top-read row built as components with instances inside auto-layout sections
